I think Aeroplane is the apogee and apotheosis for the album as a form. They did everything. They did all of it painfully well. well enough to confuse reviewers. well enough that if you're not paying attention you just think they're doing themselves, not everything else. Well enough to grab a generation (which, I'm not sure... I discovered them several years too late).
